summary: Diff adds a VoiceSearchButton component, a useSpeechRecognition hook using the Web Speech API, and integrates the mic button + speech-to-text flow into HomePage to auto-fill the search input and navigate to /search. Most requirements appear implemented; Tamil/English support may be only partially addressed because recognition language is configured only as ta-IN in HomePage.

missing_requirements.requirement: Support both Tamil and English speech recognition for voice search, configured to work for typical Tamil/English mixed queries.
missing_requirements.reason: HomePage configures speech recognition language as only 'ta-IN' (with a comment claiming it will understand English too), but the diff does not show any explicit configuration or strategy to ensure English recognition (e.g., switching/dual-pass, user locale-based selection, or explicit 'en-IN'). The hook supports multiple language options, but the actual integration shown uses only Tamil.
